tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background: the disc itself. Everything on the device sits on it. Also the ink of the "!" inside a filled status triangle.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Secondary ground for panels sitting on bg. Behind the disc in these previews.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Row fill, editing-row fill. Text on it is ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled arc track, chart gridlines, hairline guides. Decorative only: never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Inactive page dots, outlines that must be seen (3:1 on bg and surface-2 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, readings, knob, icons. On bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, hints, status-bar icons, OFFLINE. On bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus and selection only: focused list row, edit border, value-adjust arc and knob, chart line, primary button fill. Never a measured status. Not for text on surface-2 in the day theme.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status OK: reading inside its range. Blue, so it is never told from danger by red-green hue. Always paired with the word OK or a check glyph.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status WARN: reading near its limit, and threshold lines (dashed). Always paired with the word WARN or the triangle glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status ALERT: reading beyond its limit. Always paired with the word ALERT, a cross or the triangle glyph.

tokens.name: rain-1
tokens.usage: Light rain (Pluie faible) on the Weather page's next-hour rain arc. Rain intensity only, never a status.

tokens.name: rain-2
tokens.usage: Moderate rain (Pluie modérée, or an unknown rain text) on the rain arc.

tokens.name: rain-3
tokens.usage: Heavy rain (Pluie forte) on the rain arc: the deepest blue.

styles.name: value-xl
styles.usage: lv_font_montserrat_48. The hero reading, one per screen, centered in the arc.

styles.name: value-l
styles.usage: lv_font_montserrat_40. Reading when a second line of content shares the screen.

styles.name: value-m
styles.usage: lv_font_montserrat_28. Readings in quadrant and chart screens, alert values.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: lv_font_montserrat_20. Screen titles, list rows, alert headline.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: lv_font_montserrat_16. Sentences and hints longer than two words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: lv_font_montserrat_14. Sensor names, units, status text. Smallest size for anything the user must read.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: lv_font_montserrat_12. Chart axis ends and state words under a reading only. Never for a sentence.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: lv_obj pad between glyph and text in a status label; ring-inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked labels; gap between ring (r 106) and content circle (r 98).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding is 12; row padding 12.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row side padding; gap between a reading and the next group.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between screen title and reading.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Largest vertical gap; separates reading block from status area.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chart plot corners, small keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows and cards.

size.note: Fixed geometry of the 240 x 240 round display. Pixels, one-to-one with the framebuffer.

tokens.name: ring-w
tokens.usage: Width of the bezel arc (lv_obj_set_style_arc_width) on MAIN and INDICATOR.

tokens.name: ring-inset
tokens.usage: Gap between the display edge and the arc's outer edge; arc object is 232 px.

tokens.name: ring-gap
tokens.usage: Angle between the segments of the Room page's segmented ring (about 7 deg visible after the rounded ends).

tokens.name: content-r
tokens.usage: Radius of the content circle inside the ring: nothing but the ring is drawn outside it.

tokens.name: safe-box
tokens.usage: Largest square that fits anywhere in the content circle with a margin; use for rectangular widgets such as charts.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable target on a touch panel.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: List row height; also the focus row in menus.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: Weather icon in the hourly forecast strip (glyph of the custom icon font).

tokens.name: icon-l
tokens.usage: Weather icon on the current-conditions screen.

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: Optional room icon shown before the room name (glyph of the icon font).

tokens.name: opa-pressed
tokens.usage: Touch-pressed state of any tappable element.

tokens.name: opa-dim
tokens.usage: Unfocused rows next to the focused row in a list (ink at this opacity keeps 4.5:1 on bg).

tokens.name: opa-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Text at this opacity is exempt from contrast: also say why it is disabled.
